harvest.headline: Nothing here is older than today.
harvest.body: We sow after you order and cut on the morning we deliver. No cold room in between.
harvest.alt: Bundles of green and purple microgreens on a striped cloth by a sunlit window, scissors beside them.

bowl.headline: A week of greens, in one bowl.
bowl.body: The mix changes every week, so the same box never arrives twice.
bowl.alt: A speckled ceramic bowl heaped with mixed red and green microgreens on a wooden block.

plate.headline: A handful lifts the whole plate.
plate.body: Salads, toast, soup, a smoothie — added last, raw, at the table.
plate.alt: A sunlit table of dishes topped with microgreens: a salad bowl, a green smoothie, soup, avocado toast and a grain bowl.

trays.headline: Grown in our own trays.
trays.body: Checked by hand before sowing, because poor seed means poor greens.
trays.alt: Trays of red and green microgreens on a wooden counter beside a small dish of seed.

pinCheck.served: Yes — we deliver to {pin}. Your first box would arrive

process.heading: Grown for your order, not for a shelf.

seed.title: Seed we trust
seed.body: From suppliers we know: non-hybrid, non-GMO, untreated, checked by hand.

trays.title: Clean tray, new medium
trays.body: Trays sterilised before every sow, with fresh coco peat we never reuse.

sown.title: Sown on your order
sown.body: Nothing speculative. Your order decides what goes into the trays.

harvest.title: Checked, cut, delivered
harvest.body: Quality inspected in the tray, cut Saturday morning, at your door that day.

otherProducts.heading: Grow your own, or eat them ready-made.
otherProducts.body: Ordered any time and delivered on the same Saturday run as the greens.

neverFrozen.title: Never frozen
neverFrozen.note: Cut and delivered the same morning
